text:
Asha: Quick review of the confirmation dialog when users delete a model version. Current primary text: `Delete version?` feels terse and scary. Also the danger button says 'Delete' with no context.
Tom: Agreed. We should make the consequence explicit and offer an affordance to keep a copy. Maybe primary: 'Permanently delete version' and secondary text explaining data retention and rollback options.
Viv: Love the explicit wording. Suggest body: 'This will permanently remove version v2.3 from the serving catalog. Logs and metrics will be retained for 90 days but you cannot rollback this version.'
Asha: That'S strong but we need to be careful about promises (e.g., retention windows vary per plan). Maybe say 'Logs and metrics may be retained per your plan settings.'
Tom: Good point. Also CTA wording: instead of plain 'Delete' use 'Delete version' and aria-label 'confirm-delete-version-v2-3' so screen readers include context.
AccessibilityBot: A11y nits: ensure dialog uses role="alertdialog" and focus moves to the heading. Provide a descriptive id for the body and reference it with aria-describedby on the confirm button. Do not rely on color; include an icon and text label.
Viv: UX nit: include a small checkbox 'I understand this cannot be undone' to prevent accidental deletes. Could be optional for enterprise customers.
Asha: Hmm want to avoid extra friction for power users. Maybe hide the checkbox behind a setting (enable confirmation step). For now, add a subtle inline note: 'This action is permanent.'
Tom: Telemetry: fire event 'model_version_delete_confirmed' with props {version, user_role, plan}. Also include which dialog copy variant was shown.
Asha: Localization: avoid idioms and keep short sentences. Use key: 'model.delete.confirm.title' and 'model.delete.confirm.body' with placeholders for version.
Viv: Proposed final copy:
Title: 'Permanently delete version?'
Body: 'This will permanently remove version {version} from the serving catalog. Logs and metrics may be retained according to your plan settings. This action cannot be undone.'
Confirm button: 'Delete version' (aria-label: 'Confirm delete version {version}')
Cancel: 'Keep version'
Tom: Looks good. I'll update the component and add the aria attributes. Asha: I'll file a localization ticket and add copy variants for testing. AccessibilityBot: Reminder 1: include visible focus ring and ensure the dialog role/labels are tested with NVDA/VoiceOver.
Asha: Thanks all, will follow up when PR is ready. :rocket:
